relations.subject: Karel Ambrož Josef Przikril
relations.evidence: After a while as teacher at archiepiscopal seminary in Goa he served as examinator and exhortator.

relations.subject: Karel Ambrož Josef Przikril
relations.evidence: Released in 1768 because of an appeal from Maria Theresia he returned to Bohemia and became Rector of Collegium in Königgrätz.

relations.subject: Karel Ambrož Josef Przikril
relations.evidence: When the S.J. was suppressed in Bohemia, too, he spent his last years at episcopal seminary.
